response.overview: On a small islet in the Chiloé archipelago, a shellfish diver lives alone in a house suspended over the sea. Time seems to have stood still amid the objects, gestures, and memories that silently inhabit the space.  While his children have gone their separate ways, he remains by the ocean, sustained by his memories and the deep conviction that he has fulfilled his role as a father. Amid that silence, he begins to prepare for one last journey.
response.title: Trabajo hecho
